sources.title: 星鏈協力廠 光寶群電入列
sources.locator: Paragraph beginning「光寶在低軌衛星布局多年」
sources.note: Reports Lite-On as a power supplier to SpaceX, and specifies household ground-receiver power supplies. The companies reportedly did not comment on individual customer order details.

sources.title: 光寶科、群電入列SpaceX「星鏈」供應鏈，盤中雙雙走揚
sources.note: Also identifies Lite-On as supplying power for household ground-receiving equipment; secondary report.

sources.title: 【光寶科法說會重點內容備忘錄】未來展望趨勢 20251029
sources.locator: Section 4,「非 AI 業務發展」, LEO satellite bullet
sources.note: AI-generated summary based on official exchange-hosted earnings-call video; it states Lite-On was the global largest LEO satellite power supplier. It does not define the product category or substantiate the ranking with a market-wide comparison.

sources.title: 光寶科Q2拚雙升 拉高資本支出
sources.note: Reports approximately 60–70% of the largest customer's supply and exclusive supply to the second-largest customer. This is customer-specific supply share, not a defined global market share.

sources.title: 《DJ在線》低軌衛星商轉加速 台系電源廠動能看升
sources.effective_period: Customer-share status reported as current in May 2026; future estimate also discussed
sources.note: Reports nearly 70% share at the largest U.S. brand customer and an expected decline to around 60% as that customer's shipments expand. The article describes ground-terminal power and does not provide a global-market denominator or measurement method.

search_notes: Isolated Hermes Agent run using gpt-6-luna with xhigh reasoning and web tools.
